candidate.request: Show me what I spent per month in 2025.

plan.title: Spending per month
plan.question: Total spending per month in 2025, one row per month, ordered, columns month and total_eur.

candidate.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE amount < 0
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
candidate.reasoning_plan:
the request is English, so the language is en
it compares the months of one year, which is a trend
a line reads a trend most directly
the columns are month and total_eur
the period is the whole year the data covers
candidate.reasoning_code:
the shape is line, so the mark is lineY over the rows
the columns are month and total_eur, and total_eur holds the numbers
months on x, euros on y

why: the self-check found something on the first attempt
findings: Every chart carries `tooltip: { use: tooltip, format: ... }`.
Set `grid: true` on `scales.y`, the euro axis.
The euro axis needs `axis: { ticks: { format: eurShort } }` on `scales.y`.

The euro axis has to start at zero, or a change of a few percent is drawn as a cliff. Give `scales.y` the domain `scale: scaleLinear().domain([Math.min(0, ...amounts), Math.max(0, ...amounts)])` over the figures the chart draws.
The values read as periods (2025-01, 2025-03-14), so `scales.x` needs `axis: { ticks: { format: monthShort } }`.
validated_sql:
SELECT
  STRFTIME('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month,
  ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE
  amount < 0
GROUP BY
  month
ORDER BY
  month
LIMIT 200

candidate.request: Zeig mir meine Ausgaben 2025 als Anteile nach Kategorie.

plan.title: Anteile der Kategorien
plan.question: Ausgaben 2025 je Kategorie, eine Zeile pro Kategorie, absteigend sortiert, Spalten topic und total_eur.

candidate.sql:
SELECT coalesce(category, 'Needs review') AS topic, ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY topic
ORDER BY total_eur DESC
candidate.reasoning_plan:
die Anfrage ist deutsch, also ist die Sprache de
sie fragt nach Anteilen an einem Ganzen
ein Doughnut zeigt Anteile, solange es wenige Stuecke sind
die Spalten sind topic und total_eur
der Zeitraum ist das Jahr 2025
candidate.reasoning_code:
the shape is doughnut, so pie turns the rows into slices and radialArc draws them
the columns are topic and total_eur, and total_eur holds the numbers
topic names each slice, so it is the color channel and the key
there is no x and no y on a doughnut, so both positional scales are null

why: the self-check found something on the first attempt
findings: More than one series needs a legend: `color: { legend: colorLegend({ placement: 'bottom' }) }`.
